requirement: Nodes must correspond to real entities such as hosts/endpoints/flows, not arbitrary numeric-feature rows.
Edges must arise from observed source relationships such as SrcIP→DstIP traffic.
Labels, attack categories, predictions, SHAP/LIME/IG values, or performance cannot define graph edges.
Renaming/reindexing nodes must not change the underlying graph relation.
Node and edge construction must be deterministically reproducible from source fields.
A future experiment must be able to prevent train/validation/test leakage through shared edges, graph context, or future observations.
Prefer relational metadata available across the complete source universe.
Timestamp availability allows time-local graph snapshots if needed.
